messages:
Maya Kaur: Alert from payments team: two customers reported duplicate charges this morning. I see duplicate payment_intent.succeeded events processed by our webhook handler -> created two successful payments in Stripe and NetSuite only linked one. Dropping logs and proposed mitigation.

payments-webhook-bot: [alert] webhook-forwarder job 1785001111 FAILED/REPLAY_DETECTED: event_id=evt_3DupeReplay attempts=3 last_status=200

James Patel: Can you paste the raw webhook payloads (ids masked) so we can confirm replay vs separate events?

Maya Kaur: sample sequence (redacted):
```json
{
  "id": "evt_1Abc...",
  "type": "payment_intent.succeeded",
  "data": { "object": { "id": "pi_9Xyz...", "amount": 5000, "customer": "cus_123...", "metadata": {"invoice_id":"inv_2026_11"} } },
  "received_at": "2026-05-02T08:12:10Z"
}
--- replayed payload ---
{
  "id": "evt_1Abc...",
  "type": "payment_intent.succeeded",
  "data": { "object": { "id": "pi_9Xyz...", "amount": 5000, "customer": "cus_123...", "metadata": {"invoice_id":"inv_2026_11"} } },
  "received_at": "2026-05-02T08:12:18Z"
}
```

Ravi Shah: Looks like Stripe retried the same event (same evt id) and our HTTP handler accepted both because we only dedupe on idempotency-key header, which Stripe doesn't send for event re-deliveries. We should dedupe on event.id (evt_*). Current code uses X-Idempotency-Key first, falls back to none. Bug introduced in payments gateway refactor (commit e12d4).

James Patel: Short-term mitigation: add middleware to reject duplicate event.id within 24 hours (store seen event IDs in Redis with TTL). Also pause forwarding for the last 30s window and manually reconcile affected customers.

Maya Kaur: I'll pause the webhook-forwarder (done at 1785001200) and run a small script to mark duplicates as ignored for processing. Also opening FIN-2026-210 for accounting reconciliation and refunds.

billing-ops-bot: [info] webhook-forwarder paused by Maya Kaur at 1785001200 (reason: duplicate event replays)

Ana Gomez: Accounting: how many duplicates and dollar impact? We need to notify customers and determine refunds or journal reversals.

Maya Kaur: Quick tally: 5 duplicate payments processed (total $275.00 USD) across 3 customers. Two duplicates already captured in Stripe as separate charges. NetSuite linked only one of each pair (other payments appear in NetSuite as unlinked payments). I recommend issuing full refunds for the extra charges and posting reversing journals in NetSuite for any matched differences.

Ravi Shah: I'll push a hotfix to the webhook handler now: store event.id in Redis before processing; if seen -> return 200 without reprocessing. Also add CI test to simulate Stripe retry behavior. Hotfix deploy link: https://deploys.redwood/prod/14821 (deploy id 14821).

James Patel: After deploy, post the job run id for the reconciliation re-run so accounting can validate. Also include the Redis key format.

Maya Kaur: Hotfix deployed at 1785001325. Replayed job re-run id: wf-reprocess-1785001350. Reconciler accepted events and did not create new payments. Accounting: I initiated refunds for the two captured duplicate charges and created reversing journals for the unlinked payments. Ticket FIN-2026-210 updated with actions and customer outreach copy.

Ana Gomez: Thanks. Action items in FIN-2026-210: 1) eng-payments to add event.id dedupe + CI test (owner: Ravi) 2) payments + accounting to complete refunds/journals and confirm reconciliation (owner: Maya) 3) create alert when duplicate Stripe charge count > 1 in a single run (owner: billing-sre). Please include customer notification timeline and who approved the refunds.
